Glad to see the Czech Republic is on the list, I'm Czech and I definitely have to recommend it. Things aren't perfect due to us being on the wrong side of the iron curtain but honestly I believe we are an up and coming country with good prospects for the future. Prague is much better off than the rest of the country so if you want to come I strongly recommend moving to the capital although places like Brno and Plzen are decent too. Here are some pros and cons in no particular order.

Pros:

  • Decent life quality

  • Very low unemployment

  • Cheap

  • Lots of things to do, culture, visiting nature or seeing some amazing sights from the past.

  • Great public transportation system (Prague)

  • Best beer in the world (sorry Germans) that is incredibly cheap

  • Weed is easy to find and if the cops catch you all you get is a fine (unless you have more than 10g iirc).

  • Tons of historical buildings everywhere

  • Safe, crime rates are very low

  • Very few people are religious (could be a con for somebody else though)

  • Great location in the center of Europe

  • Very homogeneous (although for a foreigner that could be a con). I think Prague has the the ideal amount of multiculturalism. Some foreign restaurants and shops but no large migrant populations that would create ethnic neighborhoods.

  • Open minded, freedom loving culture. Just do what you like, nobody will judge. Perhaps this is why we were declared the most degenerate country and rank at the bottom of the nanny state index (i.e. we have the most freedom and some of the best conditions for alcohol, smoking, drugs, gambling, prostitution etc.). We have some of the largest rates of alcohol, marijuana consumption in the world. For me personally as I partake in these things it's a pro. If you are some moralist then it would be a con.

Cons:

  • Wages can be quite low, but it depends where you work. If you get a job with some foreign company in Prague you can live very comfortably

  • Inefficient bureaucracy (but then again that is true for most countries)

  • The typical czech cuisine in my opinion isn't very good, luckily there are tons of restaurants with food from all over the world

  • No sea and the weather is not great but not too bad either

  • Corruption
